description: S46 T3 (MG5-reads): mcp.grants {agent} is the person's per-agent authority view — S12's GrantView VERBATIM (qualified/tier/state/reason, MG7: a second derivation is the bug this slice exists to prevent), plus the two facts that explain it: `core` (NULL = no narrowing — the whole core set; [] = core narrowed to nothing, two distinct facts the mcp_agent.core column's own discipline carries to the wire) and `declares` (MC5: declaring is the grant; usability still needs S10's allow — the two facts shown SEPARATELY, never silently combined). A withheld row carries missingClasses (the S12 Refusal pointer distinction: absent = this refusal is not about classification). An unknown agent refuses with the typed named-thing code, not this success.

grants.reason: core: judged by the step's S11 policy gate (S12 does not re-decide core)
refused: tool "acme-crud.delete_issue" is unclassified — its rerun and effect classes must be declared before it can be offered (MC6)
